name: @bridge/table-embed
description: The Bridge table as a portable, self-contained React component: real game law, real table, no platform.
//types-beside-the-bundle: The build also copies index.d.ts to dist/table-embed.d.ts, so a host that VENDORS the artifact and imports './table-embed.js' by path — rather than resolving the package name — still gets types: TypeScript substitutes a sibling .d.ts for a .js import. Without it such a host typechecks against whatever tsc can infer from a rolled-up bundle, which is worse than nothing: it reports every optional prop as required.

scripts.build: vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp dist/index.d.ts dist/table-embed.d.ts
